Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.opensurvey

Class SurveyDatabaseElementResolver

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.opensurvey.SurveyDatabaseElementResolver
public class SurveyDatabaseElementResolver extends Object
SurveyDatabaseElementResolver finds the catalogued element that a database survey annotation describes, so that the annotation's AssociatedAnnotation relationship links to the schema, table or column it measures rather than to the surveyed asset.

The catalogued elements are found by following relationships down from the surveyed asset and matching on the name the database uses: resourceName for a database, which the database templates set to the database name (or displayName for a database catalogued without a resourceName), and displayName for schemas, tables and columns, which the JDBC cataloguer sets to their names. This means it does not depend on how the qualified names of the catalogued elements were formed. The path followed is:
  • SoftwareServer - SupportedSoftwareCapability - capability - CapabilityAssetUse - RelationalDatabase (only when the surveyed asset is a database server)
  • RelationalDatabase - DataSetContent - DeployedDatabaseSchema
  • DeployedDatabaseSchema - Schema - schema type - AttributeForSchema - RelationalTable
  • RelationalTable - NestedSchemaAttribute - RelationalColumn
If the element an annotation describes has not been catalogued, the annotation is linked to the surveyed asset. A survey produces its annotations database by database, schema by schema and table by table, so only the children of the most recently used database, schema and table are cached.

    • getDescribedElementGUID

      public String getDescribedElementGUID(DatabaseElementAnnotation annotation) throws InvalidParameterException, UserNotAuthorizedException, PropertyServerException
      Return the unique identifier of the catalogued element that the annotation describes, or the surveyed asset if that element has not been catalogued.
